brand_notes: Q Acoustics 3000i-series standmounts (3020i, 3030i) remain on the maker's US site at $349.96 / $499.96 per pair though What Hi-Fi? says 3000c replaced them (3020c launched). 5000 series (5010 $999, 5020 $1,199 pair) uses C3 curved-cone driver and sealed isolated tweeter; Erin's 5020 data show a treble-heavy response and 3.4 ohm minimum. All models rated 6 ohm with claimed minimums 3.3-4 ohm. Maker claims 88 dB for 3000i vs measured 85.6-86.1 dB (nrc-q-acoustics-3020i, asr-q-acoustics-3020i); 5020 claim 87.9 vs 86.7 measured (eac-q-acoustics-5020).
takeaways: Klippel LW ±2.0 dB (good) but 3.5 dB ER dip, bright top end, f3 77 Hz
Min impedance 3.9 Ω (ASR) / ~3.5 Ω (NRC, graph) vs 6 Ω rating: flagged effectively-4ohm
Woofer THD ~3.3% at 96 dB near 100 Hz, much worse below 60 Hz
Critics warm and good value; ASR bright, not recommended without EQ
conflicts: Warm (What Hi-Fi?) vs bright (ASR) tonal description
